name: llc.carrier/mcp
title: Carrier
description: Programmable eSIM and mobile connectivity: manage fleets, plans and orders from your agent.

environmentVariables.name: CARRIER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Carrier API key (ak_...). Starts the server and enables the storefront management tools only. OCS tools need CARRIER_OCS_API_TOKEN and durable inventory tools need CARRIER_API_TOKEN. Set at least one of the three: with none the server exits.

environmentVariables.name: CARRIER_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your own authenticated Carrier API credential. Needed for durable inventory tools such as assign_package. The server will not start unless this, CARRIER_API_KEY or CARRIER_OCS_API_TOKEN is set.

environmentVariables.name: CARRIER_OCS_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OCS API token for the explicit OCS tools. Not a Carrier API credential. Set this, CARRIER_API_KEY or CARRIER_API_TOKEN: the server will not start with none of them.
